_meta.about: Generated by tools/recipes/ingredients.py from recipes_table.json, data.json and the loot tables in x/. Do not edit by hand.
_meta.effort_rule: effort = minimum over sources (shops, herb nodes, monster drops); computed by the script, no per-ingredient overrides

effort_scale.1: shops >= 10 and (herb: also a herb node; mineral / alcohol / other: shops alone; monster parts and mutagens never)
effort_scale.3: shops 1..4, or a common monster drop: >= 2 monster loot tables with chance >= 35% (always counts as 100%), unless the item carries tag mod_valuable
effort_scale.4: all shops in a single DLC region (none in base game), or a less common monster drop: a monster loot table with chance >= 10% (or always) that is not common as in 3
effort_scale.5: anything else: monster drops below 10%, container / quest / unique tables only, no known source

_meta.ingredients: every item in a full or copy list of recipes_table.json, except lower-level potions and bombs
not_modelled: respawn: monster loot has no respawn data in the XML (respawn_time 0); herb entries carry respawn_time 1440 but it is not used
how many monsters of a kind exist or how far they are
quest rewards and crafting of ingredients (e.g. White Gull 1 can be brewed)

sources.containers: containers, treasure hunt and unique tables (count only)
sources.monsters: tables in def_loot_monsters.xml / def_loot_animals.xml / def_loot_actors.xml (names identify the monster, e.g. _monster__Ghoul, Drowner Nest); chance in percent per kill, "always" (-1 in the XML) stored as 100; the best chance per table is kept
sources.other_tables: living world, quest and other loot tables (count only)
sources.shops: loot tables with "store" in the name in *shop*.xml; region = folder the XML came from (base, ep1 = Hearts of Stone, bob = Blood and Wine); stock is counted whatever the entry chance (almost all shop entries are "always")

threshold_notes.MONSTER_COMMON_CHANCE: 35% separates deliberate drops (Ghoul blood, Nekker heart: always; Drowner brain: 45/35) from borderline ones (Endriag heart 30/26, Nekker 20)
threshold_notes.MONSTER_COMMON_TABLES: 2 tables: one lucky table is not a source; nest and boss tables count as tables because they are real drop places
threshold_notes.MONSTER_LESS_CHANCE: 10% is still worth hunting for; below it the part is incidental loot
threshold_notes.RARE_TAG: loot tables do not say how rare a monster is (Golem heart drops always, golems are rare); the game tags its rarer parts mod_valuable, so they never reach level 3 via monsters

_meta.type_rules: mutagen: tag MutagenIngredient; alcohol: tag StrongAlcohol; herb: tag HerbGameplay or icon folder herb; monster_part: icon folder monstrous or alchemy/food_*; mineral: other icon folder alchemy; other: the rest (Optima mater, Powdered pearl, Oil)
